post.description:
Creates a new company account for the authenticated company.
These will be used for payments from the app

requestBody.description: The company account request containing the company account code to update and updated information.

patch.summary: Changes the state of a company account (active/inactive).

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The code of the company account to update.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: The new status of the company account (true or false).

get.summary: Retrieves a company account by its code.

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The code of the company account to retrieve.

get.summary: Retrieves all company accounts associated with the authenticated company.
